turns.question: Which of 1 or 2 October 2026 had more precipitation in Amsterdam, and how many orders were placed by customers in the Netherlands on that day?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no precipitation or weather metric, so I cannot say which day was wetter (the closest metrics are only the order metrics, e.g. Orders), and so I cannot pick "that day"; for reference, customers in the Netherlands placed 3 orders (cancelled included) on 1 October 2026 and 3 orders on 2 October 2026.
